effect.fr: Tenu: Les capacités de type Glace du porteur infligent 20% de dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.en: Held: Ice-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a heat- repelling piece of ice that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.
